verdict.rationale: HubSpot publishes an extensive, well-documented public REST API (CRM objects, contacts, custom objects, webhooks, CLI) with clear endpoints like POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts, plus an official MCP server for AI-agent read/write access to CRM data. Probes show no llms.txt/openapi.json at expected static paths, but the documented developer portal itself covers the API surface. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness/rate limits.
